[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Marion Glasgow was born by 9 June 1751 and baptised that day at Kirknewton and East Calder, daughter of James Glasgow and Katharine Rule. The transcript gives Kirknewton residence and records her as female.<ref>[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_686207987&tab=this Findmypast fmp-record-r-686207987], inspected derivative transcript,25October2026; original register uninspected.</ref>


The Kirknewton Churchyard inscription records Marion Glasgow, daughter of James Glasgow, tenant in Newton, as dying on 20 July 1774 aged 23. Her name, father, parish and age fit this 1751 child; the identification is qualified because the original stone/image has not been inspected.<ref>[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_691902723&tab=this Findmypast R_691902723], inspected derivative transcript, 25 October 2026; original uninspected.</ref><ref>[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=GBPRS%2FSCOT%2FMIS%2F511328&tab=this Findmypast GBPRS/SCOT/MIS/511328], inspected derivative transcript, 25 October 2026; original uninspected.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Page 27 transcript review, 25 October 2026 ===
The new companion confirms the 9 June baptism, not an exact birthday. The death inscription does not name her mother or independently identify James with his childhood profile. The father assessment remains 74% probable; Katharine Rule remains separately unassessed.


=== Parish transcript review,25October2026 ===
The imported 9June 1751 birthday reproduces the baptism day. The inspected derivative supplies no exact birth date, so only an inclusive birth bound is approved. The selected father Glasgow-3486 remains 74% probable, mother Rule-2358 separately unassessed. The parental names are now reproduced from the transcript; the earlier dated review’s statement that they were not reproduced is superseded.

Earlier biography, retained as a superseded account: Marion was born in 1751.


=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3486]] is assessed at 74% (probable). Marion’s specific 1751 Kirknewton index fits James/Katharine Rule’s family and a plausible paternal age about 21. The father’s 1730 date appears estimated, but no record parents are reproduced.

Complete selected father-profile proposition; recorded role and adult identification distinguished below.

Next useful test: Read the 1751 entry for James and Katharine Rule and their marriage.
